note: Adds a shared count_is_member helper holding the count>=1 floor and calls it from both daily_predicate and compressed_predicate.
Replaces manual request.data list checks with a BulkNotificationIdsRequestSerializer applied via @validated_request on both bulk endpoints.
Drops active_filter from list_entities, makes list_feature_flags public, and the tool now calls list_feature_flags directly with the filter.
Renames WizardCloudRunHandleDTO to WizardCloudRunDTO and updates serializers, views, generated clients and tests.
Moves OIDC public-key derivation out of the auth class into a shared get_oidc_public_key in posthog/jwt.py; rest of token handling stays local.
Renames the server class to IngestionSessionReplayServer and the mprocs process to ingestion-sessionreplay, but the plugin server mode name stays recordings-blob-ingestion-v2.
Inputs now raise generic ValueError; the activity catches it around client construction and raises the non-retryable missing-inputs error.
Removes the useMemo option merge from the component and reads a mergedOptions selector from the kea logic instead.
Keeps defaults in the Max tool, adds a feature-flag gate mirroring the web UI and reports contexts; nothing moves into the serializer.
Enriched conditions gain a display {tone,label} in the kea selector plus an errorDisplay selector; the component uses a style lookup table instead of ternaries.
Renames the flag to phai-llm-gateway and its helper, but the provider is hardcoded to bedrock rather than read from a flag payload.
Adds create_skill to skill_services and routes the tool through it, removing the local duplicate-name error, open-coded create and IntegrityError fallback.
Extracts the field-stringify function into a shared common row_transforms module and uses it from the Intercom source.
compose_stage2 now takes (LeafStateKey, Uuid) pairs; the seed path pushes plain pairs instead of synthesized Entered transitions.
Renames the settings slug to ai-observability and adds hash-param redirects; the llmAnalyticsDashboard url helpers keep their names.
Renames the AgentMode key LLM_ANALYTICS to AI_OBSERVABILITY across mode registries, schema and frontend usages.
Adds a shared isReachable Postgres probe to test-reset; no generation or CI equivalence check of the table fixture against migrations.
Deletes the HogFlowScheduledRun model and migration, adds next_run_at on HogFlowSchedule, and reworks schedule_sync and endpoints accordingly.
Replaces the RepoSelection mirror with the tasks RepoSelectionResult and drops LineReference; the duplicated enums are left as they were.
Replaces the nested ternary for alert kind with an insightAlertKindForQuery function in alertFormLogic.
